# Asset reports merge components and record contact

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. Enroll an Asset

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",
  "request_id": "<asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<asset credential>",
  "alias": "Alpha"
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "asset": {
    "alias": "Alpha",
    "change_sequence": 1,
    "command_manifest": [],
    "components": {
      "communications": {
        "link_state": "offline"
      },
      "heartbeat": {
        "last_seen": null
      },
      "status": {
        "reported_at": null,
        "value": "unknown"
      }
    },
    "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
    "id": "<asset>",
    "kind": "asset",
    "subtype": null,
    "version": 1
  },
  "credential_id": "<id-2>",
  "principal_id": "<id-3>"
}
```

## 2. A check-in with telemetry and health records contact but not status time

SDK `POST /entities/<asset>/checkin` with <asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<report 1>",
  "sequence": 1,
  "components": {
    "telemetry": {
      "latitude": 42,
      "longitude": -71,
      "altitude_m": 20
    },
    "health": {
      "battery_percent": 90
    }
  }
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "alias": "Alpha",
  "change_sequence": 2,
  "command_manifest": [],
  "components": {
    "communications": {
      "link_state": "healthy"
    },
    "health": {
      "battery_percent": 90
    },
    "heartbeat": {
      "last_seen": "<time>"
    },
    "status": {
      "reported_at": null,
      "value": "unknown"
    },
    "telemetry": {
      "altitude_m": 20,
      "latitude": 42,
      "longitude": -71
    }
  },
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "subtype": null,
  "version": 2
}
```

## 3. A patch replaces present fields, clears null ones and replaces the manifest

SDK `PATCH /entities/<asset>` with <asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<report 2>",
  "sequence": 2,
  "components": {
    "telemetry": {
      "altitude_m": null,
      "speed_mps": 3
    },
    "health": null
  },
  "command_manifest": []
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "alias": "Alpha",
  "change_sequence": 3,
  "command_manifest": [],
  "components": {
    "communications": {
      "link_state": "healthy"
    },
    "heartbeat": {
      "last_seen": "<time>"
    },
    "status": {
      "reported_at": null,
      "value": "unknown"
    },
    "telemetry": {
      "latitude": 42,
      "longitude": -71,
      "speed_mps": 3
    }
  },
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "subtype": null,
  "version": 3
}
```

## 4. A status component sets status and its report time

SDK `PATCH /entities/<asset>` with <asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<report 3>",
  "sequence": 3,
  "components": {
    "status": {
      "value": "ready"
    }
  }
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "alias": "Alpha",
  "change_sequence": 4,
  "command_manifest": [],
  "components": {
    "communications": {
      "link_state": "healthy"
    },
    "heartbeat": {
      "last_seen": "<time>"
    },
    "status": {
      "reported_at": "<time>",
      "value": "ready"
    },
    "telemetry": {
      "latitude": 42,
      "longitude": -71,
      "speed_mps": 3
    }
  },
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "subtype": null,
  "version": 4
}
```

## 7. A null status is rejected by the Protocol

SDK `PATCH /entities/<asset>` with <asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<report 5>",
  "sequence": 5,
  "components": {
    "status": null
  }
}
```

→ **400**
```json
{
  "code": "invalid_request",
  "message": "The request does not match the Protocol at /components/status: Value is not nullable."
}
```

## 8. Clearing longitude alone would leave a partial position

SDK `PATCH /entities/<asset>` with <asset credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<report 5>",
  "sequence": 5,
  "components": {
    "telemetry": {
      "longitude": null
    }
  }
}
```

→ **400**
```json
{
  "code": "invalid_request",
  "message": "Latitude and longitude must be supplied together."
}
```
